thread:
maya: Solarflare confirms two EAP units for next week. They want our bench harness and a short mutual NDA. Can someone own bench + perf keys? @oscar?
oscar: I can take bench ownership. Quick Q: test matrix fp16/int8 or include q4? Also suggested soak to expose thermal behavior.
claire: Legal: we'll accept a mutual embargo but insist on aggregated metrics only and synthetic prompts. I'll review their redline when uploaded.
ben-ops: Lab receives Tue/Wed only, carrier preference UPS. Need COA form, serials, and whether partner preloads drivers. We refuse shipments outside window.
tom-solarflare: We'll sign NDA after minor redline. We can preload drivers and provide a container image to a temporary s3 link. Default stress config: `--threads=48 --seq=4096`. Thermal starts to vary after ~25m.
oscar: Proposed bench plan: 2 cold runs (cache off) per model/quant, 1 warm run for latency, 1x 40m soak with telemetry. Metrics: p50/p95 latency, sustained tokens/s, avg_power, max_gpu_temp. Example run we'll include in bench repo:
```
./bench.sh \
  --model redwood/fast-7b \
  --seq 4096 \
  --batch 1 \
  --quant int8,fp16 \
  --threads 48 \
  --collect gpu_power,gpu_temp,gpu_freq,mem_bw \
  --soak 2400 \
  --synthetic-prompts true
```
maya: Marketplace note: need SKU and short partner blurb. Suggest SKU: SOLAR-EAP-1 / region: us-east-1. Marketing pick up? @grace-marketing
grace-marketing: OK, will draft listing copy once we have metrics and logo. Need embargo date to align PR. Two-week lead for assets please.
claire: NDA redline link: https://solar-files.s3/nda_redline_v1.pdf. Legal requires data-handling addendum for scrubbed traces only.
tom-solarflare: Uploading logo and driver manifest after NDA signature. We agree to synthetic prompts and aggregated metrics. We'll accept mutual embargo of 10 business days.
ben-ops: I'll schedule pickup for Mon evening to hit Tue lab window. Please send serials + COA. Ops will refuse any package >30kg.
oscar: Action items:
- oscar: bench harness + parsers + example run by Fri (3311300000)
- ben-ops: confirm lab window + COA form (due Mon 3311250000)
- claire: finalize NDA + data addendum (due Wed 3311240000)
- tom-solarflare: upload signed NDA, image, logos, driver manifest (ETA Mon)
- grace-marketing: draft marketplace blurb & PR timeline (due Thu 3311290000)
maya: I'll send a 30min kickoff invite and include the checklist. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
